languages.name: F#
languages.description: Functional-first .NET language reference focused on pipelines, algebraic modeling, async workflows, and interoperability.

entries.title: let bindings
entries.summary: Bind immutable names to values or functions.
entries.definition: Bind immutable names to values or functions.
entries.mental_model: Names are immutable by default and often represent computed values.

entries.title: Functions
entries.summary: Define functions with curried parameter syntax.
entries.definition: Define functions with curried parameter syntax.
entries.mental_model: Functions naturally accept one argument at a time and can be partially applied.

examples.title: Example
examples.code:
let add a b = a + b
printfn "%d" (add 20 22)
examples.explanation: Defines and calls a curried function.

entries.title: Pipeline operator
entries.summary: Pass a value into the next function using |> for left-to-right data flow.
entries.definition: Pass a value into the next function using |> for left-to-right data flow.
entries.mental_model: Turn nested calls into readable data pipelines.

entries.title: Function composition
entries.summary: Combine functions into a new function with >> or <<.
entries.definition: Combine functions into a new function with >> or <<.
entries.mental_model: Build new behavior by wiring outputs into inputs.

examples.title: Example
examples.code:
let trimAndUpper = System.String.Trim >> fun s -> s.ToUpperInvariant()
printfn "%s" (trimAndUpper " wyn ")

entries.title: Pattern matching
entries.summary: Select and destructure cases using match ... with.
entries.definition: Select and destructure cases using match ... with.
entries.mental_model: Pattern matching is central to data-driven control flow.

examples.title: Example
examples.code:
let label x =
    match x with
    | 0 -> "zero"
    | _ -> "other"

categories.name: Data Modeling
categories.description: Records, discriminated unions, options, and results.

entries.title: Records
entries.mental_model: Concise immutable data structures with structural equality.

examples.title: Example
examples.code:
type Macro = { Key: string; Language: string }
let m = { Key = "M1"; Language = "Python" }

entries.title: Discriminated unions
entries.summary: Define closed sets of named cases that may carry data.
entries.signature: type Name = | A | B of T
entries.definition: Define closed sets of named cases that may carry data.
entries.mental_model: Algebraic alternatives designed for exhaustive pattern matching.

examples.title: Example
examples.code:
type ImportMode =
    | Strict
    | Merge
    | Failed of string

entries.title: Option
entries.summary: Represent presence or absence as Some value or None.
entries.definition: Represent presence or absence as Some value or None.
entries.mental_model: Absence is encoded in the type rather than null.

examples.title: Example
examples.code:
let found = Some "Wren"
match found with | Some x -> printfn "%s" x | None -> ()

entries.title: Result
entries.summary: Represent success or failure as Ok value or Error error.
entries.definition: Represent success or failure as Ok value or Error error.
entries.mental_model: A typed two-track outcome ideal for pipelines.

entries.title: Tuples
entries.summary: Group a fixed number of positional values.
entries.definition: Group a fixed number of positional values.

examples.title: Example
examples.code:
let pair = "M5", "Scala"
let key, language = pair

categories.name: Collections and Async
categories.description: Lists, sequences, arrays, computation expressions, and tasks.

entries.title: Lists
entries.summary: Use immutable linked lists for recursive/functional processing.
entries.definition: Use immutable linked lists for recursive/functional processing.
entries.mental_model: Immutable linked sequence optimized for head/tail processing.

examples.title: Example
examples.code: let evens = seq { for n in 1..10 do if n % 2 = 0 then yield n }

entries.title: async computation expression
entries.summary: Compose nonblocking asynchronous workflows with async { ... }.
entries.definition: Compose nonblocking asynchronous workflows with async { ... }.
entries.mental_model: A computation expression supplies specialized sequencing semantics.

examples.title: Example
examples.code:
let work = async { do! Async.Sleep 10; return 42 }
printfn "%d" (Async.RunSynchronously work)

entries.title: task computation expression
entries.summary: Compose .NET Task-based asynchronous code with task { ... }.
entries.definition: Compose .NET Task-based asynchronous code with task { ... }.

examples.title: Example
examples.code: let work = task { do! System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Delay 10; return 42 }

categories.name: .NET Interop and Modules
categories.description: Organization and direct use of the .NET ecosystem.

entries.title: Modules
entries.summary: Group functions, values, and types into named namespaces.
entries.definition: Group functions, values, and types into named namespaces.
entries.mental_model: Modules are lightweight organizational containers for functional code.

examples.title: Example
examples.code:
module Labels =
    let macro key = key.ToUpperInvariant()

entries.title: .NET interoperability
entries.summary: Instantiate and call .NET classes directly from F#.
entries.definition: Instantiate and call .NET classes directly from F#.
entries.mental_model: F# shares the CLR and base class library with C#.
